headline: Town Center Master Plan update, plus a business community update and EDC alliances report.
summary: The agenda lists a Town Center Master Plan update, a business community update, and a report on EDC alliances. Public comment, correspondence, and an executive session, if the town attorney recommends one, are also on the agenda.
items: Executive session, if recommended by the town attorney
plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, 
CONNECTICUT 
 
ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT 
COMMISSION 
 
REGULAR MEETING AGENDA 
 
5:30 PM, NOVEMBER 10, 2026 
 
 
Hamden Government 
Center 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
Fax:  (203) 287-7075 
 
Meeting Agenda: The Economic Development Commission, Town of Hamden, will hold 
a Regular Meeting on Tuesday, November 10, 2026 at 5:30 PM via Zoom. 
 
Comments for this meeting can be heard by joining the meeting via Zoom and participating 
in the public input session, or you can submit them in writing to 
hbc_economicdev@hamden.com 24 hours prior to the scheduled meeting (If you submit a 
comment, you can still speak during the public input session). You will have 3 minutes to 
speak and will be notified when you have 30 seconds remaining to avoid being muted at 
the completion of 3 minutes.  
 
Please click the link below to join the webinar: https://hamden.zoom.us/j/85161997686 
 
Meeting ID: 851 6199 7686 
Dial In:  +1 646.558.8656 US (New York)  
Participants without Zoom access may still be able to join the meeting (in listen-only mode) 
by (1) dialing the above number and (2) enter the meeting ID: 851 6199 7686 (3) followed 
by #.  
1. CALL TO ORDER 
 
2. ATTENDANCE 
 
3. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES 
 
  1. Meeting Minutes for October 13, 2026 
4. PUBLIC COMMENT 
 
5. CORRESPONDENCE 
There will be a brief summary of the correspondence submitted between the last 
correspondence update and this one. This includes but is not limited to any 
correspondence with council members that members wish to submit for the record. It can 
also include written communication to the council from the administration, community 
members, etc.
6. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney) 
7. CHAIRMAN'S REPORTS 
 
  1. Business Community Update 
  2. EDC Alliances 
  3. Town Center Master Plan 
8. DIRECTOR'S REPORT 
 
9. OLD BUSINESS 
 
10. NEW BUSINESS 
 
11. ADJOURNMENT 
 
  
NOTE: The public may address any item on the agenda of a regular or special meeting and any 
matter within the purview of a Board or Commission at a regular meeting either electronically or 
in person, unless otherwise set forth or constrained by Law of the provisions of this Charter.
